site.title: JAGAVE — Coffee, reimagined for everyday radiance

hero.subheadline: Freeze-dried Arabica coffee blended with vegan collagen peptides and a considered mix of skin-supportive nutrients — all in one convenient 10 g sachet.
hero.sideText: Instant · Plant-based · Made for daily use

manifesto.label: Our Intention
manifesto.title: A cup of coffee can be part of a more considered morning.
manifesto.text: Jagave brings together the familiarity of coffee and a purposeful blend of nutrients selected to complement a daily beauty and wellness routine. It is not a medicine or a shortcut. It is simply an easy, enjoyable ritual designed to fit into the morning you already have.
manifesto.signature: "Radiance is built through the rituals you return to."

principles.title:
Three ideas,
blended into every sachet.
principles.description: The formulation is being developed around daily usability: a satisfying coffee experience, purposeful ingredients, and a format simple enough to become a habit.

items.title:
Coffee First,
Without Compromise.
items.body: Freeze-dried Arabica coffee forms the heart of each sachet, supported by a plant-based creamer for a smooth, rounded cup. The goal is a familiar coffee ritual with no unnecessary preparation.

items.title:
Purposeful Ingredients,
Clearly Presented.
items.body: The blend combines vegan collagen peptides with glutathione, vitamin C, rice ceramosides, sodium hyaluronate, astaxanthin, vitamin E, zinc, biotin and other carefully selected nutrients. Exact formulation remains subject to final manufacturing and regulatory review.

items.title:
Made to Mix,
Made to Repeat.
items.body: The sachet is being refined for smooth mouthfeel, reliable dispersal in water or milk, and a clean finish. Ingredient forms and flavour balance may be adjusted before launch to improve the drinking experience.

formula.title:
Seven highlights
from the formula.
formula.description: The full blend contains additional supporting ingredients. These seven highlights have been selected for the website to keep the story clear and the layout focused.
formula.meta: → Seven ingredient highlights · 10 g sachet · Pre-launch formula

ingredients.name: Freeze-Dried Arabica Coffee
ingredients.description: The familiar foundation of the ritual, selected in an instant format for convenience and a full coffee character. The classic sachet contains 5.0 g; the hazelnut version contains 4.5 g.

ingredients.name: Vegan Collagen Peptides
ingredients.description: A plant-based, microencapsulated or hydrolysed collagen analogue included as one of the formula's central beauty-focused ingredients.

ingredients.name: Liposomal Glutathione
ingredients.description: A liposomal form of glutathione selected for the formulation and presented as part of the product's broader antioxidant-focused nutrient blend.

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.description: Microencapsulated vitamin C included to complement the wider formula and support a convenient daily nutrient ritual.

ingredients.name: Rice Ceramosides
ingredients.description: Rice-derived ceramosides included as a compact, skin-focused component of the blend.

ingredients.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
ingredients.description: A low-molecular-weight form of sodium hyaluronate selected for the formula's hydration-focused ingredient story.

ingredients.name: Astaxanthin
ingredients.description: A naturally associated antioxidant nutrient used in a small but purposeful amount within the broader blend.

ritualMeta.title:
One sachet,
one simple ritual.
ritualMeta.description: Jagave is designed to fit into an ordinary morning without specialist equipment or a complicated routine.

ritual.title: Empty one sachet.
ritual.description: Add one 10 g sachet to your cup. Use the classic coffee formula or the coffee + hazelnut variation.

ritual.title: Add hot water or milk.
ritual.description: Pour in your preferred amount of hot water or milk. Final preparation guidance will be confirmed after taste and solubility testing.
ritual.detail: Water or milk · Serving size to be finalised

ritual.title: Stir until smooth.
ritual.description: Stir thoroughly or use a small frother for a creamier finish. The formulation is being optimised for easy mixing and minimal residue.

ritual.title: Make it part of your morning.
ritual.description: Enjoy it as a consistent daily ritual alongside a balanced diet and your usual skincare routine.
ritual.detail: Daily ritual · Coffee first · No medical claims

preview.title: A ritual in three parts.
preview.description: Jagave is still in development. Explore the coffee, the formula and the simple daily practice the product is being designed around.
